continuity.reading: silence is measured between the ticks that consumed a slot, because a trigger that found its slot already sealed is not a gap in the observation

declared_rule.reading: a day counts only if every primary asset holds at least 90% of the bars the calendar expects for its timeframe, and only if those bars reached the store while they were still fresh; the frozen corpora are older than the epoch and no day before it is a forward observation day

freeze.reading: the frozen corpora end at these instants; every stored bar is strictly later, and no day before the epoch is a forward observation day

live_coverage_full.not_an_admission: reaching the floor makes a later decision possible; it does not make it, and this lane cannot promote a strategy
live_coverage_full.not_counted: days before the observation epoch, and days whose bars arrived long after they closed, are not forward observation days: a backfill is history, not an observation
live_coverage_full.rule: a day counts only if every primary asset holds at least 90% of the 24 hourly bars the calendar expects for it, and every one of those bars was stored within its timeframe's lag bound of closing ({'1h': 7200000, '15m': 1800000})
live_coverage_full.window_vs_prospective: the window figure counts every stored bar after the freeze, the prospectively observed figure counts only days whose bars were stored as they closed: only the second one is an observation of the future
